autoDeleteNonMusic.label: Auto-delete non-music tracks
autoDeleteNonMusic.description: Automatically remove and delete the audio file for any track that audio analysis classifies as non-music, an audiobook, or noise. Turning this on removes any tracks like these already in your library.

nowPlayingPublic.label: Share "now playing" status
nowPlayingPublic.description: Lets a small public API endpoint report the artist and song you're currently listening to — useful for building your own status badge, stream overlay, or bot. It only reports a track while it's actively playing (not paused), and automatically stops reporting shortly after you pause, close the app, or lose connection. Anyone who knows your account email can query it while this is on, so only enable it if you're fine with that.
nowPlayingPublic.usage: Query it with a GET request to:
nowPlayingPublic.exampleResponse: Responds with {"playing": true, "artist": "...", "title": "..."} while something's playing, or {"playing": false} otherwise.

deezer.description: Connect your own Deezer account so this app can fetch missing high-quality (FLAC or 320kbps) tracks directly from Deezer as a last resort, when no other source has them. This only works with an eligible paid Deezer subscription, and only ever downloads tracks your account is already entitled to stream.
deezer.cookieHelper: Copy the value of the "arl" cookie from deezer.com while logged in (your browser's dev tools, under Application/Storage → Cookies). Treat it like a password — anyone with it can download from your account.

smtp.title: Email (SMTP)
smtp.description: Used to send signup verification emails. Leave the host blank to turn email verification off entirely — new accounts are then verified and signed in immediately.

postgres.title: Database (PostgreSQL)
postgres.description: The connection is tested before it's applied — invalid values are rejected so the app keeps running on the current database.
postgres.required: Database, username, and password are all required.

lastfm.title: Last.fm
lastfm.description: From the same free registration at last.fm/api/account/create. The API key alone powers the track page's "Discover" section; both key and secret are needed before users can connect their account and scrobble.

hq.title: HQ Downloads
hq.description: Requires a modified slskd-compatible image (see docker-compose.yml's SLSKD_IMAGE) with purchaser-IP verification built in — has no effect against a plain slskd instance.
hq.autoDownloadEnabled: Automatically download and replace files with higher-quality versions when found
hq.allowedUserProvidersDescription: Lets users connect their own account for these providers from their Profile, as an additional HQ fallback source beyond the ones above. Disabling one here hides it from every user's Profile and stops it being used during sync, even for a user who already connected it.

softReimport.title: Soft Reimport
softReimport.description: Re-normalizes titles, re-matches MusicBrainz, and redoes audio analysis/genre tagging for every video in the selected playlist — using the mp3 files already downloaded. Nothing is re-downloaded.
softReimport.started: Soft reimport started. Progress will show on the playlist's own page.
softReimport.genericError: Failed to start soft reimport. The playlist may already be syncing.

tagRebuild.title: Rebuild ID3 Tags
tagRebuild.description: Re-writes title/artist/album/track/year/genre ID3 tags on every already-downloaded mp3 in the selected playlist, using the metadata currently in the database. No network activity, no re-download, no metadata rematch.
tagRebuild.started: Tag rebuild started. Progress will show on the playlist's own page.
tagRebuild.genericError: Failed to start tag rebuild. The playlist may already be syncing.

originalTitleBackfill.title: Backfill Original Titles
originalTitleBackfill.description: Re-fetches the raw YouTube title for every track across all playlists whose original title was never saved (rows created before that was tracked) — no re-download, just a metadata lookup per track. Applies system-wide, not just the selected playlist.
originalTitleBackfill.started: Backfill started. Check the server logs for progress.
originalTitleBackfill.genericError: Failed to start the backfill. It may already be running.

export.title: Export Tracks
export.description: Export a CSV of tracks with their YouTube ID, original YouTube title, artist, and title — useful for bulk-correcting inaccurate metadata with an external tool and reimporting it via Import.

import.title: Import Tracks
import.description: Import a CSV in the same format as Export. Matches each row by YouTube ID and updates that track's artist and title — a blank artist or title cell leaves the existing value unchanged. Updated tracks are re-queued for the next HQ scan.
